clues: John Logie Baird carried out early television experiments here in 1923 and 1924.
Tall black wooden 'net huts' stand on its Stade beach, home to a beach-launched fishing fleet.
Two cliff railways climb from its Old Town.
A ruined castle built by William the Conqueror overlooks its seafront.
The famous 1066 battle named after it was fought a few miles inland, in East Sussex.
